Trailer released for 'Karavali' film featuring emotional drama and thrills

The trailer for the upcoming film 'Karavali' has been released, showcasing actors Raj B Shetty and Prajwal Devaraj. The film appears to be an intense emotional drama with elements of thrills, set against the backdrop of Kambala, a traditional buffalo race. The trailer highlights a clash between the two lead actors.
